description: One exchange security alert with its evidence signals, sources and timeline. Takes the id from muhabbit_alerts, or the article_id of an alert headline seen in muhabbit_events. A confirmed alert is free; an unconfirmed (suspected) one answers 403 alert_unconfirmed unless include_unconfirmed is true, which reads the paid route. (Free when include_unconfirmed is false, the default, and the alert is confirmed. Otherwise paid: x402 payment, or an API key or wallet token on a paid plan.)

id.description: Alert id (incident uuid) or one of its article uuids

include_unconfirmed.description: true reads the paid route, which also serves suspected (unconfirmed) alerts

name: muhabbit_alert
title: One exchange security alert
